blurb: ​Our private and secluded facility is nestled away down the alley of 530 Marine View Ave behind Alliance Drywall. Our state of the art facility includes hitting and pitching tunnels, as well as strength and conditioning equipment similar to what you would find in a standard gym. We believe in the use of technology as an aid, not an absolute in the ability to train and develop the best student-athletes possible.
